notes.title: Hark the Update: New Trailer + The Future
notes.notes:
Something lurks within these dark city streets, waiting for the perfect opportunity to make itself known… 

It’s an update!

We’ll be showcasing our latest gameplay trailer and discussing why we’ve made the decision to release ‘Hark the Ghoul’ in 2026. 

But first, here’s the new gameplay trailer 👇
[previewyoutube=bPJ15BFAF0Y;full][/previewyoutube]
We are excited to announce that we will be working alongside UK-based publisher Kwalee to release Hark the Ghoul. This newfound partnership will mean that we are able to make it an even bigger project than we’d initially planned!

With the support of a publisher, we’ll have the funding to expand the project and work on it full time. For this reason, we’ve decided to release in 2026 so we’ll be able to expand the scope of the game and make it into something truly worth harking at.

We know some of you would have loved to get your hands on the game in 2025, but rest assured the Hark the Ghoul you'll play will be an even more engrossing experience than the demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3058660/HARK_THE_GHOUL/
Want to discuss your hype with other ghoulish fiends?

Join our Discord and follow us on social media @HarkTheGhoul, where you’ll be able to hark all our updates.

notes.title: Hark the Update: Cerulean Sluice + More
notes.notes:
Where damp stone breeds secrets and spores alike, MARQUIS’s men stand sentinel over a mystery most foul. What curious alchemy transpires in these depths?

Delve into the Cerulean Sluice: a world of glowing mycelium, aggressive automatons, and a whole cast of strange characters with their own motives.

Discover new weapons, new stories, and a whole new way to travel around the world, thanks to a shady rodent.
 
Want to know more about the Cerulean Sluice and the secrets it holds? Watch the trailer here 👇
[previewyoutube=ziu9GUVgCco;full][/previewyoutube]
We are excited to announce that we will be working alongside UK-based publisher Kwalee to release Hark the Ghoul! This partnership will make the game bigger and better, with more resources available to us.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3058660/HARK_THE_GHOUL/

A damp, dark Victorian city sits under a starless sky. Its citizens, mad with desire, claw at the earth, hoping to dig up shreds of amber.

Beneath the city lie lands untold. Darkness teems with unimaginable horrors and fantastic creatures. And deep within, a glint draws the eye.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hark the devs!

The steam next fest is ON, and we're glad to see many players enjoying the game, wishlisting and leaving reviews. Thank you!


Let's get on with the patch notes:


PATCH NOTES:
BUGFIXES

Fixed a bug that would cause enemies to slide off without control when hit during an attack.
Fixed a bug where Deneb would disappear right in front of your eyes after talking.
Fixed a bug where Deneb would not disappear from GRAND RULER PLAZA after meeting him in the STARLIT CHURCH.
Fixed a bug where the Shovel weapon would stay on screen while in dialogue
Fixed an issue that caused Sap Vials not to drop from breakables.
Fixed an issue that caused the camera to freak out for half a second when exiting the character creator.


TWEAKS

Adjustments for the price of gunpowder in stores (6->15).
Adjustments for the limits of the FOV slider (60 to 75 -> 55 to 95). Default value is unchanged.


ADDITIONS

 Added the option to separately adjust "movement lean" and "camera breathing" in the options menu for accessibility reasons.
 Reworked the visual of the YOU DIED text.



See you soon!

notes.title: The Input remapping update!
notes.notes:
Hark the devs!

A new day means a new update and this one is chunky!

You can now rebind your inputs!

Additionally, we have a slew of smaller changes and fixes!


PATCH NOTES:
BUGFIXES

Fixed a bug that would cause the game to crash if you played it offline from steam.
Fixed a bug where breakable items would clip into grub cocoons.
Fixed a bug where some elements would keep wobbling even if the psx wobble toggle was unchecked.
Fixed a bug where Antares' barrels would be invulnerable in her hand after being broken once.
The speed at which gravity affects zealot eyes should now be consistent and more lenient.


TWEAKS

Adjustments for rocks (health reduced, damage when kicked increased)
Adjustments for lightstones (deal more damage)
Tweaked character creation UI to be ultra-widescreen friendly.


ADDITIONS

 Added button prompts to showcase use magic and use consumable inputs near their respective icons.
 Added input remapping menu.
 Added a slight ambient sound when in the city street's dark underground.


KNOWN ISSUES

 Some inputs cannot be chosen for remapping (namely, scroll wheel inputs).
 UI might give incorrect prompts if using exotic input mappings (i.e. additional mouse buttons)
